title: Exactness of the fixed normalized boundary
statement: For every scheme X, covering opens U,V, abelian etale sheaf F, injective resolution I of F, normalized comparison c [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison] and q>=0, the explicitly constructed boundary delta [def-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-canonical-boundary] satisfies Exact(d,delta) and Exact(delta,r), where d(x,y)=openCohomologyRestriction(U intersection V<=U,F,q)(x)-openCohomologyRestriction(U intersection V<=V,F,q)(y), and r(z)=(cohomologyMap(U inclusion,F,q+1)(z),cohomologyMap(V inclusion,F,q+1)(z)). Restrictions are the actual inverse-image coefficient comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-open-cohomology-whole-restriction-naturality]. No arrow compatibility is asserted. The BoundaryOn variant also accepts a specified intersection open with its equality, and gives the identical assertion after transport of that equality. The BoundaryOn exactness API accepts the additive difference d with its pointwise restriction formula and identifies it by extensionality in the generic scheme context. The fixed-boundary specialization uses the canonical injective resolution and its normalized comparison, with no resolution input needed by callers. The supplied difference may be any function with the pointwise actual restriction-difference formula: additivity of that function is not separately needed to assert or prove exactness.

source.place: Tag 0A50, injective-resolution section proof and coefficient functoriality, read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A50; Tag 01F7, resolution functoriality, read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01F7. Fixed normalized-comparison specialization written by S3.

proof.text: Use the short exact section complex of the fixed resolution. Identify its middle homology with the product of the two open homologies by the homology functor biproduct comparison. Construct this equivalence locally for the two section complexes; use Mathlib Functor.biprodComparison_fst and Functor.biprodComparison_snd directly to compute its coordinates. No duplicate SectionComparison helper declaration is introduced.

The normalized restriction identities identify the section-complex homology arrows with the actual restriction pair and difference. Compute the pair via HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp and biprod.lift_fst/lift_snd, and compute the difference via biprod.desc_eq and homology additivity before applying the normalized restriction identities.
Transport homology exactness at the intersection and at the successor whole term along the additive equivalences, canceling their inverses in the boundary definition.

For a specified intersection open, substitute its given equality and apply the preceding assertion. This avoids definitionally reducing a scheme restriction merely to identify its intersection presentation.
Unfold only the fixed-boundary interface and specialize the preceding proved naturality or exactness to its chosen resolution and normalized comparison.
